name: Hyprworld
author: Tristan Demers
description: A two-dimensional scrolling workspace for Hyprland on Omarchy, with visible window groups, searchable overview, smooth-fit minimap, continuous cross-monitor drag outlines, shared workspaces, placement paths, startup templates, and keyboard/touchpad controls. Settled checkpoints restore layouts after plugin resets in the same compositor session. Requires the Hyprland Lua API, Omarchy Shell, and a native helper built for the running Hyprland version.

barWidget.description: Shared workspace numbers with monitor swaps and occupied-workspace indicators
